provenance.how: constructed from the ADR's burst rule and the lane's ruling (the digest is a VISIBLE alert, not the silent attention form), and cross-checked against the core's own builder and key recipe (tests/unit/mobile/test_push_payload.py); not captured from a running relay, because no relay route emits the machine-side shapes yet

notes: A DIGEST IS NOT THE ATTENTION FORM. §3.2 fixes the attention form's envelope as a silent, best-effort wake (aps.content-available), so a coalesced catch-up riding it would arrive with no banner, no body and no count the user can read. type: "digest" is the signal the cloud's fan-out composes an ALERT from: a house constant plus the count, never a conversation name, a snippet or an error line.

No conversation, no completion_token and no kind: a digest spans conversations, so it names none of them, and a tap on it resolves nowhere — it is a "look at the app" nudge, and the app reads the truth from the machine.

COLLAPSE PER COMPUTER, not per conversation: the cloud derives apns-collapse-id / notification.tag as digest:<computer handle> from this payload's type and computer. A phone that already has banners queued for several conversations must not get one banner per conversation for a burst that is one event.
The machine sends no aps envelope (payload-forbidden-fields.json): the alert above is the text the cloud wraps, and aps.badge is never sent at all (§1.5).

alert is COMPOSED BY THE MACHINE and delivered verbatim (the lane's ruling of 2026-10-01): the title is APP_NAME, and the body's leading phrase is digest_subtitle's answer for the SET — "Complete" here because the batch is uniformly complete, "Mixed outcomes" when it is not — followed by the count. A fixed "Task complete" would announce a set of failures as complete, which is the claim the TUI's own digest vocabulary exists to refuse.

exclude means what it means on the attention form, and is REQUIRED when the digest follows an ack nudge — the device that just acted must not be told about its own action. Absent means "exclude nobody", which is what the tick-detected path sends; exclude_absent_payload is a whole valid payload, not an empty list.

The key is sha256("digest" ‖ emit_id ‖ computer) — see emit-idempotency-keys.json, which carries the worked vector. The emit_id is minted ONCE when the coalescing window closes, so a retry re-emits the same emit under the same key; re-minting per attempt would give one batch a new identity each time and defeat the cloud's dedupe (review round 1, B1).
count is §3.2's count: the machine's unread conversation count at composition time, the one aggregate the design discloses to the cloud on purpose.
